title: PlanItem
description: One change in an approval: what it changes (before and after, or a value added or removed), why, the rule and evidence, and whether a person may approve it. An item held for the board by jason's policy finding is flagged for review: it is decided only as a one-off exception (exception: true), with a reason. Items for a person, to confirm with the owner, or informational are never approvable.

id.description: sha256(kind|op|target|value)[:16]: the same on every re-plan.

op.description: The kind's verb: "member tag +", "unit tag -", "complete request", "for a person", "request stays open".

label.description: Who or what, for the reader (a name is shown; contact details never are).

group.description: The items read together: one owner.

rule.description: The rule that calls for it: a citation (CIV 4040(a)(2)) or a rule row's address.

address.description: What jason.approvals.evidence resolves from disk: payhoa:submission:N, a citation, board-item:ID, or a command.

readAt.description: When the plan read the record (UTC, ISO 8601). Absent for a citation or a command.

digest.description: sha256 of what the plan read (a request: its status and answers); the snapshot approvals/<id>.evidence.json holds the same.

basis.description: sha256 of the live state the item relies on; required of an approvable item.

boardItem.description: Held for the board: the board item it waits on.

dependsOn.description: Item ids that must apply first.

highStakes.description: A second, distinct person signs before it applies.

exception.description: A flagged item (held for the board) decided by a person as a one-off exception, whether approved, rejected, or kept flagged. Absent when false.

exceptions.description: Read only, added by jason-web beside a flagged item and never stored: the decisions made under its finding (rule) in every plan, oldest first, from the exceptions log.

exceptionCount.description: Read only, added by jason-web: exceptions approved under the item's finding.

reason.description: Required for a rejection or a hold.
